images.prompt: Visualize digital fatigue as a real energy drain. Close-up of person rubbing tired eyes with digital notification icons floating around them. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.

Introduce the core concept of renewable energy powering mental wellbeing. Animation showing renewable energy flowing into phone, then transforming into mental energy filling a person's silhouette. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.

Create parallel between digital overloads and environmental pollution. Split screen showing social media notifications flooding one side, factory emissions on the other. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.

Explain the relationship between digital storage and energy concepts. Animation showing data storage filling up, then transitioning to battery storage visualization. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.
Demonstrate digital mindfulness in practice. Person meditating with phone in another room, peaceful energy radiating from them. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.
Show mental renewal through digital detox. Person's silhouette gradually filling with calm energy as phone dims in distance. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.
Show the benefits of digital energy management. Person surrounded by growing renewable energy symbols as they become more centered. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.
Leave viewer with peaceful connection to nature. Person looking peacefully at nature, with digital devices minimized in the background. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.
Final reinforcing visual. Peaceful nature scene with digital devices gradually fading away. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.
Final fade out. Screen fading to black with subtle energy particles. Cinematic, high detail, 16:9, no text overlay.
